name: manual_140602
claim: When installing or running first-run bootstrapping across PT and orama, detect AntiGravity (~/.antigravity) and Gemini (~/.gemini) environments automatically. Harmonize the ECC runtime overlay (~/.antigravity/ANTIGRAVITY.md) and register cross-stack MCP endpoints without overwriting native configurations, adhering to the 'Synthesize, never amputate' CIDF doctrine.

decisions.notes: Prevents configuration destruction, guarantees cross-harness skill/MCP parity during first-run bootstrap, and links AntiGravity/Gemini directly to canonical repo assets without silent clobber.

rationale: Prevents configuration destruction, guarantees cross-harness skill/MCP parity during first-run bootstrap, and links AntiGravity/Gemini directly to canonical repo assets without silent clobber.
